inventory.text: CNA TRAINING SCHOOLS You Can Help Your SNF Partners Unlock $2,000 per CNA Trained Your SNF partners are missing out on $2,000 per CNA trained through CNAP's Earn and Learn program, and you can change that. As a trusted training partner, you're uniquely positioned to connect them to this funding, strengthen your relationships, and grow enrollment demand. We’ve prepared an outreach toolkit that has everything you need to get your SNF partners connected to CNAP funding. Learn How CNAP Works Download Your Outreach Toolkit WHY THIS MATTERS FOR YOUR SCHOOL Be More Than a Training Vendor. Be the Workforce Partner Your SNFs Need When SNFs access CNAP funding, they can invest more in CNA training, which means more demand for your program. CNA training schools that refer SNF partners to CNAP benefit from: Stronger SNF loyalty and preferred partner status Increased student enrollment and training volume Greater program stability and differentiation A reputation as a true workforce development partner You’re the voice SNFs already trust. Help them access funding they may not know exists and build something stronger together. Download Your Outreach Toolkit CNAP EARN AND LEARN PROGRAM Help Your SNF Partners Unlock $2,000 Per CNA Trained CNAP’s Earn and Learn program rewards California SNFs $2,000 per CNA trained and certified. Here’s what your SNF partners need to know: SNFs do not need to be a CDPH-approved training facility to participate Partnering with your approved training program qualifies them for funding Awards are paid after student certification and documentation are verified (approximately 3 weeks) Open to all California SNFs. California Association of Health Facilities (CAHF) membership not required Full- and part-time employees are eligible When SNFs grow their CNA workforce, your program grows too. Learn More About CNAP Eligibility YOUR CNAP CONVERSATION STARTER KIT Share CNAP with Your SNF Partners Everything in this kit was built with one goal: make it as easy as possible for you to get the word out. Pick what works for your workflow and go. Email Template Ready to forward directly to your SNF contacts Text Message Templates For quick, personal one-to-one outreach Social Post Templates Copy and imagery included, ready to post Newsletter / Website Copy Block Paste directly into your existing communications FAQ One-Pager Covers the program, eligibility, and how to apply Email Signature Strip A low-effort way to keep CNAP visible in every send CNAP and QCHF Branding Materials For co-branded outreach across your channels. Just add your school’s name and you’re ready to go.
